results.title: Singhara Flour Cheela Recipe: Healthy Vrat Meal
results.description: Singhara flour cheela recipe is a simple, gluten-free and vrat-friendly Indian pancake made with water chestnut flour, potatoes, fresh herbs and mild spices. Crisp around the edges and soft in the centre, this easy cheela makes a satisfying breakfast or light meal during Sawan Somwar and other fasting days.
